dedupe_keys.name: chinese national agricultural policy corpus and policy intensity scores 1982 to 2023 wu and co authors 2024

description: This dataset is a corpus of national agricultural policy documents issued by Chinese government bodies from 1982 to April 2023, with a score for the intensity of each policy computed from the weight of agricultural domain terms in its text. Sources include the 25 No. 1 Central Documents on agriculture from 1982 to 2023, identified by manual reading, and policies of the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs and other agencies, grouped by issuing department, together with the processed corpus and scoring files. Its authors validated the scores against agricultural GDP and found a strong correlation, with GDP trends lagging policy intensity by about 2.5 years. It was produced by Yehui Wu, Jianping Yang and co-authors at Yunnan Agricultural University and published as a data article on 22 May 2024. Coverage is national. The article is free under CC BY 4.0, and the data are available to download from three repositories with identical content. Caveats: intensity is a text-based measure that depends on the term weighting chosen, only national-level policies are included, and most texts are in Chinese. For simulation it provides a time series of policy pressure on agriculture that can drive or explain farm investment, land use and production in economic scenarios for China's food system. It is related to the FAO FAPDA food and agriculture policy decisions record in this catalogue.
